profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bank of America
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a passion for technology. I love learning about new things that interest me. I am driven to succeed in these areas of interest like video production, photography, and creating websites. I find that working with a team is extremely valuable, and I love exercising my creativity muscle whether it be with coding or videography. 

I am currently a software engineer at Bank of America, and I enjoy learning all that I can from my colleagues and furthering my career.
